name: Little Brat Dara
source:
The game follows a little Brat named Dara that turns Landon into a Wimpy Cuckold. Watch as your beautiful wife Autumn slowly falls into the arms of a much better-endowed bully.

[From [url=https://bottom-all-the-way.itch.io/little-brat-dara]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
游戏讲述了一个名叫达拉的小家伙将兰登变成了一个懦弱的戴绿帽子的故事。看着你美丽的妻子奥特姆慢慢地落入一个天赋更好的恶霸的怀抱。

[来自[url=https://bottom-all-the-way.itch.io/little-brat-dara]Itch.io[/url]]
